summary: Design, test, govern, and measure AI across customer journeys. Build practical experiments, guardrails, metrics, and executive roadmaps. Enrol today.
lede: AI-enhanced customer journey strategy connects AI-enabled interactions across sales, service, collections, and onboarding into a coherent operating model. This course helps you map journeys, identify high-value use cases, assess customer and operational risk, design controlled experiments, and report outcomes through accountable governance. You will build practical artefacts including journey maps, impact and feasibility matrices, experiment hypotheses, guardrails, KPI scorecards, and governance structures using RACI, decision rights, risk ownership, and stage-gate reviews. You will also explore the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, model cards, algorithmic impact assessments, and responsible experimentation while measuring outcomes such as conversion, containment, first-contact resolution, onboarding completion, complaint rates, and escalations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior professionals who sponsor, govern, design, or assure AI-enabled customer journeys across commercial and operational functions.
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to at least one customer-facing function such as sales, service, collections, onboarding, digital product, risk, compliance, or data governance. You do not need to write code or configure machine-learning models. Advanced AI topics receive conceptual and operational treatment, while journey mapping, experiment design, guardrail development, KPI design, and governance planning receive hands-on application. Bring a current or representative customer journey and any non-confidential KPI examples available to you.
